Class ParquetDataReader

Namespace
ParquetNeo.Data
Assembly
ParquetNeo.dll

Reads a Parquet file as a DbDataReader, so that it can go wherever a query result can: SqlBulkCopy, Load(IDataReader), Dapper and the like.

public sealed class ParquetDataReader : DbDataReader, IEnumerable, IDataReader, IDataRecord, IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable

Remarks

The columns are the top-level columns that hold a single value per row (not lists, maps or nested objects), or the ones named in Columns. Each is given as the .NET type its logical type stands for: int and long for plain integers, sbyte to ulong for the annotated ones, string for text, byte arrays for binary, decimal, DateTime (UTC when the column is adjusted to UTC), DateOnly, TimeOnly, Guid, Half, float, double and bool. Binary columns, including an unannotated FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY, are byte arrays. A column that no .NET type fits, such as an INTERVAL, is a NotSupportedException unless it is left out with Columns. A null is DBNull.

A row group is read into memory, column by column, when the reader reaches it, and rows are then given from memory, so a reader holds one row group at a time. The typed getters (GetInt32(int) and so on) throw an InvalidCastException when the column is of another type or the value is null.
